statement: TSMC monthly CoWoS output is reported at 75-80k wafers per month, ramping toward a 120-130k wafers-per-month target by end-2026, against 2026 CoWoS demand of roughly 1.0 million wafers versus about 370k in 2024 and 670k in 2025.
why: Packaging capacity is expanding fast, but the reported demand figure runs ahead of the annualised current ramp, so the gap between orders and available capacity persists through the ramp.

impact.mechanism: Rising packaging capacity adds accelerator supply over time, but demand quoted above the current ramp rate keeps allocation tight in the interim.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC monthly CoWoS ramp currently "75-80k" wafers per month toward a "120-130k WPM target by end-2026".

confidence.basis: Secondary analysis site estimate, not a primary TSMC disclosure.

dispersion: Current ramp quoted as a 75-80k range; target quoted as a 120-130k range.
